Fixture for the document-structure firing tests.
`setup-guide.md` is a setup guide in the shape drafts arrive in:
it opens with the history of the tool, its headings are "Overview",
"Details" and "Notes",
one paragraph carries the install and the configuration,
the procedure is a paragraph with three actions in one sentence,
the four supported platforms with their versions and package names are bulleted,
the config file is called "the settings file" in one place and "config" in another,
and "see above" appears twice.
`workshop.md` is a Japanese hands-on page:
its description list bullets what the reader does in 〜します,
its connection procedure is bulleted,
a variant of the command and a time limit sit in parentheses,
one sentence chains three checks with と,
and a hint bullets two ordered steps with 先に.
`CHANGELOG.md` is a plain,
well-formed file for the scenarios that must not fire.
